newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil soft.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil soft.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil cargoes were notionally softer as futures markets fell sharply, traders said.

An M-100 cargo was sold by one trader to another, at a time when futures markets were up 20 cents a barrel on the day, at around $119 cif NWE. The market was 70 cents lower by the day's end. Other M-100 cargoes were also on offer.
An ARA refiner bought an E-4 cargo on Wednesday from another trader at $3.50 over the three means of published quotes.
